units.source_text: 闭上眼睛……光的斑点，在眼前飘浮游荡……

en.t: He closed his eyes... spots of light drifted and floated before him...

units.source_text: 他正想抓住那斑点，谁知它突然加快速度逃走了……

en.t: Just as he was about to catch hold of the spot, it suddenly sped up and fled...

units.source_text: 简直就像斑蝥在沙地上留下的影子……

en.t: It was exactly like the shadow left by a blister beetle on the sand...
